text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—Just when I was fretting over whether I 
gave it my absolute all... I got the shock 
of my life! I couldn't believe everyone 
from the village came to cheer for me!!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Seein' all your faces gave me a huge 
boost of energy! 'Life is long, panic and 
you lose,' Grandma used to say. ...First 
off, I ain't gonna lose to myself!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"My next goal is to aim for that sparkle 
at the Victoria Mile! I'm gonna show 
everyone an even cooler run than today!"
